messages:
sam: Quick heads-up: planned maintenance for az9 tonight 22:15-00:15 UTC. Scope: NIC microcode + a staggered GPU node soft-reboot to clear a kernel regression we've seen at high util. We'll do 5 cohorts (1 rack each), 6m gap, with a short announce-hold (announce suppression) while TORs cycle. Expected impact: some cold-KV hits and transient queueing during backfill.

sam: Why az9? We have increased error traces during long tails on large-batch workloads; this is targeted to a subset of the fleet. No dedicated pools should be touched.

tara: Runbook outline:
- 21:30 UTC: merge manifest PR (HPA floor + PDB relax)
- 21:45 UTC: deploy eu-canary preheat (single-rack) to exercise kv-cache and routing logic
- 22:15 UTC: cohort 1 cordon + kvseed preheat; only after kv hit-rate >= 65% complete drain
- 22:21 UTC: cohort 2 begin, etc. 6m stagger
- If BGP withdraw occurs, smart-routing will prefer fallback regions (us-west/us-east) for new sessions.

sam: kvseed snippet we run from controlplane:
```
./tools/kvseed --region=az9 --cohort=1 --parallel=5 --target-hit=0.65 --ttl=1800
kubectl cordon gpu-az9-11 && kubectl drain gpu-az9-11 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=45
```

miguel: Can we avoid autoscaler thrash? Suggest bumping HPA min+1 and setting transient scale cooldown to 5m during the window. Also set pod disruption budgets to allow the soft drains without resync storms.

tara: Agreed. We'll apply the HPA cooldown flag in the manifest PR. I can own the PDB changes.

miguel: Cost question: if we need to spin up on-demand GPUs for warm backfill, what's the estimated max spend?

finance-bot: Ops buffer remaining: $4,800. Typical 2-rack backfill for 1hr estimated cost: $900-$1,600 depending on instance family. Tag charges with "az9-softreboot" for reconciliation.

sam: Rollback criteria:
- p95 inference latency > 300ms sustained for 5m
- error rate increase > 2% sustained for 5m
- kv hit-rate fails to reach 65% after 10m preheat per cohort

tara: Monitoring: I'll post cohort boundary screenshots: kv hit-rate, p95, GPU util, and outgoing BGP flaps. If anything looks off, call abort and we'll reintroduce cohorts after investigation.

ops-bot: [scheduled] Maintenance ticket INF-2026-201 created. Window: 2026-03-25T22:15:00Z - 2026-03-25T00:15:00Z. Pager: infra/eng-sre.

miguel: I'll watch billing and tag any burst with the charge code. Also will pre-authorize up to $2k emergency on-demand spend if necessary.

sam: Thanks all. Final checklist before 21:40 UTC: manifest PR merged, canary validated, cost-tagging enabled, on-call briefed. Ping @oncall immediately on abnormal tail metrics. :pray:
